name: nihoncode
description: Kita (キタ) — local-first Japanese practice web app

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts e2e docs AGENTS.md .prettierrc.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.e2e.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts e2e docs AGENTS.md .prettierrc.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.e2e.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js .github
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:arch && npm run check:taste && npm run check:docs && node scripts/audit-data.mjs --self-test && npm run audit:data
